name: Golden Temple
description: Visit the Golden Temple, a stunning Buddhist temple in Phnom Penh.
about_description_1: The Golden Temple, also known as Wat Langka, is a beautiful Buddhist temple located in the heart of Phnom Penh. It is one of the oldest temples in the city and is known for its stunning architecture and serene atmosphere. Visitors can explore the temple grounds, admire the intricate carvings and statues, and learn about the history and significance of this sacred site.
about_description_2: The temple is a popular destination for both locals and tourists, offering a peaceful retreat from the bustling city. It is also a place of worship, where visitors can observe monks in their daily rituals and participate in traditional ceremonies. The Golden Temple is a must-visit attraction for anyone interested in Cambodian culture and spirituality.
